## notes
- `camera` and `cut to` statements take no time; `for <dur>` sets the length of the camera move.
- Statements run in sequence; join parallel actions with `and` or use `together { }`.
- Anchors are (x, z) or (x, y, z) in meters: x east, z north, origin at the center of the set.
